comment:
* Logging interface for UI events. Normal implementation is UiEventLoggerImpl.
 * For testing, use fake implementation UiEventLoggerFake.
 *
 * See go/sysui-event-logs and UiEventReported atom in atoms.proto.

methods.name: void log(@NonNull UiEventEnum event)
methods.comment:
* Log a simple event, with no package information. Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.

methods.name: void log(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, @Nullable InstanceId instance)
methods.comment:
* Log a simple event with an instance id, without package information.
     * Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.
     * @param instance An identifier obtained from an InstanceIdSequence. If null, reduces to log().

methods.name: void log(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName)
methods.comment:
* Log an event with package information. Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * Give both uid and packageName if both are known, but one may be omitted if unknown.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.
     * @param uid the uid of the relevant app, if known (0 otherwise).
     * @param packageName the package name of the relevant app, if known (null otherwise).

methods.name: void logWithInstanceId(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, @Nullable InstanceId instance)
methods.comment:
* Log an event with package information and an instance ID.
     * Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.
     * @param uid the uid of the relevant app, if known (0 otherwise).
     * @param packageName the package name of the relevant app, if known (null otherwise).
     * @param instance An identifier obtained from an InstanceIdSequence. If null, reduces to log().

methods.name: void logWithPosition(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, int position)
methods.comment:
* Log an event with ranked-choice information along with package.
     * Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.
     * @param uid the uid of the relevant app, if known (0 otherwise).
     * @param packageName the package name of the relevant app, if known (null otherwise).
     * @param position the position picked.

methods.name: void logWithInstanceIdAndPosition(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, @Nullable InstanceId instance, int position)
methods.comment:
* Log an event with ranked-choice information along with package and instance ID.
     * Does nothing if event.getId() <= 0.
     * @param event an enum implementing UiEventEnum interface.
     * @param uid the uid of the relevant app, if known (0 otherwise).
     * @param packageName the package name of the relevant app, if known (null otherwise).
     * @param instance An identifier obtained from an InstanceIdSequence. If null, reduces to
     *                 logWithPosition().
     * @param position the position picked.

methodNames: void log(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, @Nullable InstanceId instance)
void log(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName)
void logWithInstanceId(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, @Nullable InstanceId instance)
void logWithPosition(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, int position)
void logWithInstanceIdAndPosition(@NonNull UiEventEnum event, int uid, @Nullable String packageName, @Nullable InstanceId instance, int position)
